use: a thunder strike; put the flash 2.5 s in (or set approach to 0 to start on the hit); fear, the dark, a dramatic turn
what: A slow distant rumble for 2.5 s, then three clusters of strikes at irregular intervals, two or three in each, every strike a short loud rumble (six times the roll's level, 40 % of its length) collapsing into its own rumble that rolls in slow waves, a secondary peal seconds later, a rumble bed under it all; a long dark reverb. Built to the numbers of real recordings: the weight at 80-250 Hz, the rumble a pile of arrivals. Mastered huge.
